messages.author: 37e895e0398cd486
messages.subject: Error in userGWAS
parts:
Hello,
I was able to successfully run a user specified model without individual SNP effects, however when I try to run the same model in userGWAS I get the error:

object 'ReorderModel' not found 

I can't seem to find what could be causing this error or how to fix it. This is the model I am using, if it is of help:

testmodel <- 'F1 =~ NA*Trait1 + Trait2
             F2 =~ NA*Trait3 
             F3 =~ NA*Trait4 + Trait5         
             F1~~F3
             F2~~F3
             F1~~F2
             Trait3 ~~ 0*Trait3'

Thanks,

Sarah

messages.author: d6d83e22ef3ba9f1
messages.subject: Re: Error in userGWAS
parts:
Hi Sarah, 

Were you using the std.lv = TRUE command when running the user specified model? As written I don't believe your model is identified, and the std.lv argument isn't available for userGWAS, so I'm wondering if that is causing the error. It also doesn't look like you are including the effect of a SNP in that model which is likely causing additional issues. I might try rewriting the model as below, but you should confirm this actually matches your analytic question:

testmodel <- 'F1 =~ NA*Trait1 + Trait2
             F2 =~ NA*Trait3 
             F3 =~ NA*Trait4 + Trait5         
             F1~~F3
             F2~~F3
             F1~~F2

F1~~1*F1
            F2~~1*F2
            F3~~1*F3
           F1~SNP
          F2~SNP
          F3~SNP
             Trait3 ~~ 0*Trait3'

Best, 
-Andrew
